mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the cost of capital for corporations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equity markets, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings from a weak labor market, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC for the high unemployment regime falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which signals potential economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past quarter signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has trended upward, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) and a stable federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates delayed monetary policy response to inflation, increasing stagflation risks and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS < 130000.0) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 130000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
